lessons.title: Derive form from a business relationship
lessons.summary: Teach a useful relationship in actual material: whole/detail, diagnosis/repair, source/result, local place/service reach, or preparation/meeting. Let it influence hierarchy across the page. Use verified facts and inspected assets; the visual metaphor remains a design hypothesis. Avoid imposing a metaphor on a straightforward task.
lessons.principle: Derive form from a business relationship

applicability.uncertainty: Check the actual page task and evidence before applying; unknown signals are not negative evidence.

relationships: derive form from a business relationship

lessons.title: Group by meaning before drawing containers
lessons.summary: Teach grouping through proximity, shared alignment, whitespace, rules, or enclosure. Decide which items belong together before choosing a card or background. Use for labels, descriptions, captions, prices, actions, and proof. Avoid visually equating unrelated information.
